title: Shiinaha oo Kenya siiyay 15 deeq waxbarasho, codsiyada waxay xirmayaan 18 November
summary: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Kenya ayaa sheegtay in Safaaradda Shiinaha ay xaqiijisay 15 deeq waxbarasho oo dowladda Shiinaha bixiso, oo loogu talagalay ardayda doonaysa shahaadada koowaad, master iyo PhD sanad-dugsiyeedka 2027/2028, sida ay werisay Capital FM.
originalTitle: China opens 15 government scholarships for Kenyan students, sets November 18 deadline
imageNote: Sawir sharci ah oo ku habboon warkan weli lama helin

en.title: China offers Kenya 15 scholarships, applications close on 18 November
en.summary: Kenya's Ministry of Education said the Chinese Embassy confirmed 15 Chinese government scholarships for students seeking bachelor's, master's and PhD degrees in the 2027/2028 academic year, Capital FM reported.

ar.title: الصين تمنح كينيا 15 منحة دراسية والتقديم يغلق في 18 نوفمبر
ar.summary: قالت وزارة التعليم الكينية إن السفارة الصينية أكدت 15 منحة دراسية من الحكومة الصينية للطلاب الراغبين في دراسة البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه للعام الدراسي 2027/2028، بحسب كابيتال إف إم.

fr.title: La Chine offre 15 bourses au Kenya, candidatures jusqu'au 18 novembre
fr.summary: Le ministère kényan de l'Éducation indique que l'ambassade de Chine a confirmé 15 bourses du gouvernement chinois pour des études de licence, master et doctorat pour l'année universitaire 2027/2028, selon Capital FM.

nl.title: China biedt Kenia 15 beurzen aan, aanmelden kan tot 18 november
nl.summary: Het Keniaanse ministerie van Onderwijs zegt dat de Chinese ambassade 15 beurzen van de Chinese overheid heeft bevestigd voor bachelor-, master- en promotiestudenten in het academisch jaar 2027/2028, meldt Capital FM.

it.title: La Cina offre al Kenya 15 borse di studio, domande entro il 18 novembre
it.summary: Il ministero dell'Istruzione keniota ha detto che l'ambasciata cinese ha confermato 15 borse del governo cinese per studenti di laurea, master e dottorato per l'anno accademico 2027/2028, riferisce Capital FM.

de.title: China bietet Kenia 15 Stipendien an, Bewerbungsschluss am 18. November
de.summary: Kenias Bildungsministerium teilte mit, die chinesische Botschaft habe 15 Stipendien der chinesischen Regierung für Bachelor-, Master- und Promotionsstudierende im Studienjahr 2027/2028 bestätigt, berichtet Capital FM.

tr.title: Çin, Kenya'ya 15 burs sunuyor, başvurular 18 Kasım'da kapanıyor
tr.summary: Kenya Eğitim Bakanlığı, Çin Büyükelçiliği'nin 2027/2028 akademik yılı için lisans, yüksek lisans ve doktora öğrencilerine yönelik 15 Çin hükümeti bursunu doğruladığını açıkladı, Capital FM'in haberine göre.

es.title: China ofrece a Kenia 15 becas, las solicitudes cierran el 18 de noviembre
es.summary: El Ministerio de Educación de Kenia dijo que la embajada china confirmó 15 becas del Gobierno chino para estudiantes de grado, máster y doctorado en el curso 2027/2028, según Capital FM.
